''Kowet'' ([[Dunglish]] pronunciation of "Go Ahead") | founded = {{Start date and age|1902|12|2|df=y}} | stadium = [[De Adelaarshorst]] | capacity = 10,400{{cite web | url=https://stijn.linearecta.be/stadiumspot/Nederland/GoAhead.htm | title=De Adelaarshorst – Go Ahead Eagles }} | chairman = Jan Willem van Dop | manager = [[Joseph Oosting]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Dutch football updater|GoAheadE}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|GoAheadE2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|GoAheadE3}} | current = 2026–27 Go Ahead Eagles season | website = {{URL|https://www.ga-eagles.nl/}} | pattern_la1 = _gae2526h | pattern_b1 = _gae2526h | pattern_ra1 = _gae2526h | pattern_sh1 = _gae2526h | pattern_so1 = _gae2526hl | leftarm1 = ff0000 | body1 = ff0000 | rightarm1 = ff0000 | shorts1 = ffffff | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _gae2526a | pattern_b2 = _gae2526a | pattern_ra2 = _gae2526a | pattern_sh2 = _gae2526a | pattern_so2 = _gae2526al | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 171c31 | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = _gae2526t | pattern_b3 = _gae2526t | pattern_ra3 = _gae2526t | pattern_sh3 = _gae2526t | pattern_so3 = _gae2526tl | leftarm3 = 171c31 | body3 = 171c31 | rightarm3 = 171c31 | shorts3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = 171c31 }} The '''Go Ahead Eagles''' are a Dutch professional [[association football|football]] club from the city of [[Deventer]] in the [[Provinces of the Netherlands|province]] of [[Overijssel]]. They play in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], having achieved promotion from the second tier [[Eerste Divisie]] in the 2020–21 season. The club's home stadium since 1920 is [[De Adelaarshorst]]. The club have won the national championship on four occasions: in 1917, 1922, 1930 and 1933. They also won the [[KNVB Cup]] in [[2025 KNVB Cup final|2025]] for the first time. The Go Ahead Eagles have trained and produced several notable athletes including [[Raimond van der Gouw]], [[René Eijkelkamp]], [[Marc Overmars]], [[Paul Bosvelt]], [[Jan Kromkamp]], [[Victor Sikora]], [[Bert van Marwijk]] and [[Demy de Zeeuw]] while providing [[Henk ten Cate]], [[Erik ten Hag]] and [[Leo Beenhakker]] with their first management experience."}}
